blocks.prompt: 3. A parabolic arch has 120 m base and height 25 m. Find the height of the arch at a point 42 m from the centre of the base.
blocks.explanation:
Arch (mehraab) neeche ki taraf khulne wala parabola hai, jaise ulta U.
Diya kya hai? Base 120 m chaura hai aur arch ki oonchai 25 m hai.
Find kya karna hai? Base ke centre se 42 m door arch kitna ooncha hai.
Plan: vertex (arch ki choti) ko origin banayenge, \(x^2 = -4ay\) lenge, base ke ek sire se \(4a\) nikalenge, phir \(x = 42\) rakhenge. Aakhir mein yaad rakhna hai ke height base se chahiye, choti se nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya: base 120 m, oonchai 25 m.
Maloom karna: base ke centre se 42 m door arch ki oonchai.
Tareeqa: origin arch ki choti (vertex) par, \(y\)-axis khari. Arch neeche ki taraf khulta hai, is liye \(x^2 = -4ay\) lete hain. Minus sign isi liye hai ke parabola neeche khul raha hai.

Base ka ek sira
Base ke sire centre se 60 m daayen aur baayen hain, aur choti se 25 m neeche:
\[A(60,\ -25)\]
Kyun: 120 ka aadha 60 hai. Origin choti par hai aur base us se 25 m neeche, is liye \(y = -25\).

\(4a\) nikalein
\[60^2 = -4a(-25)\]
\[3600 = 100a \Rightarrow a = 36\]
\[4a = 144,\quad x^2 = -144y\]
Kyun: point \(A\) arch par hai, is liye equation ko satisfy karta hai. Do minus mil kar plus ban gaye, aur \(a\) positive aaya, jo hona chahiye tha.
Dhyan dein: agar yahan \(a\) negative aata to samajh lein ke kahin sign ki ghalti hui hai; \(a\) hamesha focus aur vertex ka faasla hai, jo positive hota hai.

Centre se 42 m door wala point
\[42^2 = -144y\]
\[y = -\dfrac{1764}{144} = -12.25\]
Kyun: \(x = 42\) rakha. \(y\) choti se naapa ja raha hai, to iska matlab hai ke yahan arch choti se 12.25 m neeche hai.

Base se oonchai
\[25 - 12.25 = 12.75 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: choti base se 25 m ooper hai, aur yeh point choti se 12.25 m neeche, to base se \(25 - 12.25\).
Dhyan dein: bahut se bachay 12.25 m likh kar ruk jate hain. Woh choti se neeche ka faasla hai, sawal base se oonchai poochh raha hai.

Tasdeeq
\[y = 25\left(1 - \dfrac{42^2}{60^2}\right) = 25(1 - 0.49)\]
\[= 12.75\]
Kyun: agar origin base ke centre par rakhein to arch \(y = 25\left(1 - \frac{x^2}{3600}\right)\) banta hai (\(x = 0\) par 25, \(x = 60\) par 0). Is se bhi wohi jawab aaya, to jawab pakka hai.
